The appellant has been tried and convicted for an offence under ad sections 7 read with section 16(1)(a)(i) and 7(3) read with section M 16(i)(a)(i) of Prevention of Food and Adulteration Act and sentenced to suffer R.I. of 6 months and fine of Rs.1000/- under section 7 read with of section 16(1)(a)(i) and sentenced to suffer R.I. of 6 months and fine of rt Rs.1000/- under section 7(3) read with section 16(i)(a)(i) with default ou stipulations.
